candidates.text:
Introduce a “Temporary / Neutral Material / Unclassified Articles”:
1. Under this section all the articles that not get resolved will come with “Generic Article Description” (From PDF).
2. This section will not allow to ‘Add Articles”, “Delete Section”, “Edit Section”, “Copy Material from Items”, “Update Supplier Reference”, “Delete Articles”.
3. This section articles will only allow to send the articles for “Material Code Request”, user also not able to mark these articles as “Put on hold”, “Ready For processing”, “Price Request”, “Consumption Request”.
4. This section articles will come as “On Hold” and if user try to run the MRP these generic articles will not go for MRP generation.
5. If Unclassified section articles go for “Material Code Request” and actual articles will be attached so particular BOM line need to go its corresponding Section automatically (As Ready for Processing) based on “Cost Sheet Template”.

chunks.title: Purpose
chunks.heading: Purpose
chunks.text: The purpose of this document is to stabilize and enhance the material code request feature.

chunks.title: Business Requirement
chunks.heading: Business Requirement
chunks.text: At present, in the buyer PDF of the tech pack (Apparel), we receive information about fabric and trim articles. There can be two scenarios: either the particular material (fabric or trim) already exists in the WFX system, or it is a new material. If the material does not exist in the WFX system, it is automatically mapped to a ‘Generic Article Description’. However, there are some challenges and loopholes that need to be addressed and enhanced.

chunks.title: Scope
chunks.heading: Scope
chunks.text:
This document contains the below scope:
• A provision is required to add the ‘Generic Article Description’ in a specific section of the Bill of Materials.
• An option is required to allow “partial attachment of articles” to a material code request when multiple generic article descriptions exist.
• Automatic update of Purchase UOM and Consumption UOM in the Bill of Materials after attaching the actual article through the Material Code Request.
• The wastage percentage should be auto-updated when the costing wastage slab is used.

chunks.title: Introduce a “Temporary / Neutral Material / Unclassified Articles”
chunks.heading: Solution › … › Introduce a “Temporary / Neutral Material / Unclassified Articles”
chunks.text:
In the buyer PDF, we generally receive the article description or article name along with specific components such as Main Fabric, Zipper, Shell, or Interlining. These components vary across different buyers.
Currently, these components are hard-coded, and based on this hard-coding, the system places the articles under the ‘Fabric’ or ‘Trims’ sections in the Bill of Materials.
The correct approach should be based on the article name/article description system should need to put all “Generic Articles” under one section – “Unclassified Articles”.
• Under this section all the articles that not get resolved will come with “Generic Article Description” (From PDF).
• This section will not allow to ‘Add Articles”, “Delete Section”, “Edit Section”, “Copy Material from Items”, “Update Supplier Reference”, “Delete Articles”.
• This section articles will only allow to send the articles for “Material Code Request”, user also not able to mark these articles as “Put on hold”, “Ready For processing”, “Price Request”, “Consumption Request”.
• This section articles will come as “On Hold” and if user try to run the MRP these generic articles will not go for MRP generation.

chunks.title: Acceptance Criteria (Wastage)
chunks.heading: Solution › Acceptance Criteria (Wastage)
chunks.text:
• Unclassified article handling on bill of material.
• Materials code request enhancement changes.
• A separate screen will be introduced after user select the Article and click on the Material Code Request, to provide a consolidated view of all Article Flex Fields, irrespective of their associated categories.
The purpose of this screen is to enable designated users to review, validate, and process Unclassified articles efficiently. It will display key information through columns such as Article PDF Description, User, and all configured Article Flex Fields.
The User column will play a critical role in routing, allowing the system to automatically direct material code requests to the specified user for verification and approval. This eliminates the need for manual reassignment or repeated request submissions to different users, thereby streamlining the workflow and improving operational efficiency.
Once User will click on this Material Code Request a new screen popup
• In the above screen, the user will fill in all the relevant field details before submitting the request for approval. The approver will be selected in the User column. Upon clicking the Confirm button, the material code request, along with all the entered details, will be automatically routed to the designated approver specified in the User column.
Changes in Material Code Request Page for above point.

chunks.title: Acceptance Criteria (Wastage)
chunks.heading: Solution › Acceptance Criteria (Wastage)
chunks.text:
• The Category column will be removed, as all articles will now be treated as unclassified. Currently, the Category field restricts the ability to search for articles across different categories. Removing this column will allow users to search and view all articles without category-based limitations, thereby improving accessibility and usability.
• A multi-select option will be provided to enable the approver to select multiple records simultaneously. This will allow the approver to perform partial approval or rejection of requests, offering greater flexibility and improving overall processing efficiency.
• Problem Statement- Auto Resolved Articles from PDF
Currently, when articles are resolved automatically from the buyer PDF, the system maps the article based on previous Material Code Requests and historical references. However, in many cases, the complete article description is not available in the buyer PDF. Due to this limitation, the system may resolve and attach an incorrect article automatically.
As a result, users may face issues in identifying whether the mapped article is correct, which can lead to incorrect BOM mapping and further processing issues.

chunks.title: Acceptance Criteria (Wastage)
chunks.heading: Solution › Acceptance Criteria (Wastage)
chunks.text:
Solution - To address this issue, whenever any article gets auto-resolved from the PDF, the system should provide an option for the user to send that article for Material Code Request verification, if required. The auto-resolved article should remain attached by default for reference purposes.
Additionally, users should have the flexibility to change or replace the attached article before submitting or approving the Material Code Request. This enhancement will improve validation accuracy, provide better user control, and reduce the chances of incorrect article mapping.
